metaDescription: Compare how you see yourself with how people who know you experience you. 10Signal makes the common signals and differences between your self-perception and outside perception visible.

hero.desc: Compare how you see yourself with how people who know you experience you. 10Signal makes the common signals and differences between your self-perception and outside perception visible.
hero.ctaFree: Start free · See your first results in minutes
hero.caption: Same table, different perspectives
hero.loggedInCallout: Your dashboard is ready. Read your social reflection, incoming evaluations, and the gap layer in one place.

opening.quote: We think we know ourselves. But people who know us often carry something we cannot see:
opening.quoteItalic: how we look through their eyes.
opening.desc: 10Signal is not a test. It doesn't box you in. Instead, it places your own narrative side by side with the silent observations of your close circle — and opens up a space for you to see yourself in that subtle gap.

experience.title: A reading in three movements.
experience.desc: First, you tell your story. Then, your circle contributes silently. The final movement is where the two meet.
experience.m1Text: You share how you see yourself right now in your own thoughts. This is your starting point.
experience.m2Text: People who know you contribute anonymously. It's not individual answers that matter, but repeating common signals.
experience.m3Text: Your self-perception and outside perception come together. You see where you align and where you diverge.
experience.illustrationAlt: Watercolor illustration showing Self, Outside, and Gap layers

contexts.title: 10Signal is not just a test.
contexts.desc: You can explore how people experience you in different scenes of your life.
contexts.c1Text: Add the 10Signal link to your profile. Let people see how you present yourself and how you are experienced.
contexts.c2Text: Get feedback from your close circle and explore the common signals that connect you.
contexts.c3Text: Examine the relationship between first impressions and how you see yourself.
contexts.c1Alt: Watercolor illustration of two people sharing 10Signal cards on mobile phones
contexts.c2Alt: Watercolor illustration of friends discussing 10Signal readings in a circle
contexts.c3Alt: Watercolor illustration depicting first encounters and social impressions

howItWorks.title: 10Signal in 3 Steps
howItWorks.desc: Bringing your self-perception and outside observations together in 3 simple steps:
howItWorks.s1Text: Complete a quick self-assessment to shape your narrative and get your digital Self card.
howItWorks.s2Text: Share your custom link on social media or with friends to gather anonymous feedback.
howItWorks.s3Text: Watch your dashboard update live as responses roll in, showing where you align or diverge.
howItWorks.illustrationAlt: Example 10Signal result showing self and outside perception woven together with watercolor layers

layers.title: Results consist of four layers.
layers.desc: Each layer is based on an explainable dimension measured by 10Signal. Together, they tell how you see yourself and how people experience you.
layers.l1Desc: The self-perception layer showing how you describe yourself right now.
layers.l2Desc: A summary of repeating common signals in people who know you.
layers.l3Desc: Common and diverging aspects between self-perception and outside perception.
layers.l4Desc: Reflects how you read people when you contribute to a friend.

collection.title: Every result has its own language.
collection.desc: 10Signal results are not just a description; they offer a shareable identity and a collection piece to explore.
collection.illustrationAlt: Watercolor illustration of golden-framed collectible 10Signal code cards

security.title: Designed to be secure.
security.p1Text: Participant identities are completely hidden, individual answers are never shown.
security.p2Text: Results are generated only from repeating common data, not single inputs.
security.p3Text: Your perception data is never shared with third parties or commercialized.
security.illustrationAlt: Watercolor illustration depicting security and anonymity as a portrait transforms into an anonymous silhouette

finalCta.title: Compare how you see yourself and how people experience you.
finalCta.desc: Start your 10Signal experience and discover the common signals seen by people who know you.

pricing.title: Value first, offer second.
pricing.desc: The core experience is free. When you want a deeper read, you can continue with a one-time report.
pricing.freeDesc: Create your profile and access basic perception analysis for free.
pricing.freeF2Desc: Free quota for up to 20 friend evaluations
pricing.freeF3Desc: Overlap of self and outside perception
pricing.plusDesc: Unlock all deep analytics and unlimited respondent capacity in one single step.
pricing.plusF1Desc: Collect unlimited evaluations without the 20-response limit
pricing.plusF2Desc: View 10-signal scores and detailed answer breakdowns
pricing.plusF3Desc: See the most and least contemplated questions
pricing.plusF4Desc: Track visitor volume and response conversion rates
